title: Anchorage → Bozeman
description: Alaska 737 MAX 9 on the tarmac at Ted Stevens Anchorage, bound for Bozeman Yellowstone. Live METAR. Start up, taxi, and depart south over Cook Inlet.
author: Markus Leutwyler
